name: Cindy Hyde-Smith
summary:
Cindy Hyde-Smith (née Hyde; born May 10, 1959) is an American politician serving since 2018 as the junior United States senator from Mississippi. A member of the Republican Party, she served from 2000 to 2012 in the Mississippi State Senate, and from 2012 to 2018 as the Mississippi Commissioner of Agriculture and Commerce.
Born in Brookhaven, Mississippi, Hyde-Smith is a graduate of Copiah–Lincoln Community College and the University of Southern Mississippi.
